posts.title: Announcing the Frontiers in Psychology Corpus: 21,000+ Papers Ready for Concept Mining
posts.description: We’re excited to release a comprehensive linguistic corpus of 21,084 papers published in Frontiers in Psychology between 2010 and 2021. This dataset is specifically designed for computational linguistics research and semantic analysis—and it’s fully compatible with our high-performance concept mining tool, ConceptSketch .
